# `aube root`

- **Usage:** `aube root [-g --global]`
- **Effect:** read-only

Print the path to `node_modules`

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube root
```

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/node-modules) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Flags

- **`-g --global`** — Print the global package directory instead of the project's
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
